top_choice_rationale: Ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling is mature (about three decades of independent confirmation, daily use in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis), mechanistically a ligand-design achievement, and has the cleanest allocation: Buchwald and Hartwig built complementary general systems in parallel. The 2010 overlap is answered by scoping the citation to ligand control of C-N bond formation, and excluding Kosugi, Migita, Guram and Rennels as precursors on generality should be stated openly. Among the degrader trios I prefer the Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli PROTAC citation over the Handa version because the latter joins two distinct strands (heterobifunctional design and cereblon glue mechanism) under three names.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; he is a synthetic organic chemist at Lund, and the only tie to the slate is general field proximity to cross-coupling chemistry, with no documented collaboration with Buchwald or Hartwig
